name: error-codes
description: Exercises 4 of the 5 stable error codes (protocol.md): sqlite_error (bad SQL), bad_request (wrong params shape, and -- since v0.1.1, see https://github.com/amisonnet8/san-db-ox/issues/1 -- a missing required field), unsupported_op (unknown op), io_error (load from a nonexistent path). read_only is covered separately in read-only-mode.json since it requires the process to be started with --read-only.
